- Tue 2028-03-14, 10:00–11:00

1) 5m — introductions & goals
2) 15m — test setup & artifacts (what we ran)
3) 25m — results walkthrough (p95/p99, tail behavior, sample transcripts)
4) 10m — mitigation options & next steps (quant/kv caching/throughput plan)
5) 5m — action items + SOW notes

Can you confirm stakeholder list (engineers, security, procurement) so we include the right folks on the invite? If procurement needs the SOW draft in advance I can attach a version.

Thanks —
